name: flight history uses one travel lookup
expectedOutput: A concise list of destinations in the user's flight history.

name: career lookup uses one career tool
expectedOutput: A concise summary of the user's saved work experience.

name: general question uses no private-data tools
expectedOutput: A direct conversational answer without private-data lookup.

name: travel and career request calls tools in requested order
input: First tell me where I have traveled, then summarize my work experience.
expectedOutput: A concise answer grounded in both the user's travel and career records.

name: place and travel request calls both history tools
input: Tell me which places I have visited and where I have flown.
expectedOutput: A concise answer grounded in the user's place-visit and flight history.

name: trip briefing uses travel and career data
input: Prepare a concise personal briefing for an upcoming Tokyo trip using my travel history and work experience.
expectedOutput: A grounded briefing that separates facts from suggestions.

name: saving a job posting pushes the full posting once
input: Save this job for me. I just read the posting: Senior Engineer at Acme, remote (US), posted 2026-10-20, $180,000-$220,000 a year. It's on Ashby at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme/1b2c3d4e-0000-4000-8000-00000000abcd. Description: Own the ingestion pipeline and mentor two engineers.
expectedOutput: Confirms the posting was saved to the user's applications.

name: pushing a posting that is already saved reports the duplicate
input: Add this to my applications: Senior Engineer at Acme, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme/9f1c2d3e-0000-4000-8000-00000000beef?utm_source=linkedin
expectedOutput: Tells the user the job was already saved instead of claiming a new one.

name: a partial posting with no salary still saves
input: Save this role: Product Designer at Northwind, https://northwind.example/careers/designer. No salary listed and I haven't read the whole description.
expectedOutput: Confirms the role was saved without inventing salary details.
